fields.title: Custom prediction column name
fields.description: Allows you to specify a custom name for the prediction column appended to the input table. If not set, <tt>Prediction (trainingColumn)</tt> (where trainingColumn is the name of the target column of the provided SOTA model) is used as the default.

fields.title: Append columns with normalized class distribution
fields.description: If selected, a column is appended for each class value with the normalized probability of this row belonging to that class. The probability columns will have names like: <tt>P (trainingColumn=value)</tt>.

fields.title: Suffix for probability columns
fields.description: Suffix appended to the probability column names. The columns will be named like: <tt>P (trainingColumn=value{suffix})</tt>.
